customManagers.description: Go toolchain pinned as ARG GO_VERSION in Dockerfiles (must match go.mod; see make go-version-check)

packageRules.description: test/ and examples/ are scanned only so the Go toolchain ARG stays in sync; keep their other deps unmanaged as before
The golang builder image tag is driven by ARG GO_VERSION (customManagers), not the dockerfile manager
Bump the go directive on patch releases too (the default treats it as a minimum and never moves it), and ship it with the Dockerfile ARGs in one PR
